info.name: CivicVoice API
info.description:
All 26 CivicVoice endpoints (PROJECT_CONTEXT.md Section 11) plus the negative cases API01-API21 (Section 14.2).

Run it top to bottom with the Collection Runner against a freshly seeded database (mysql -u root -p -e "source database/civicvoice_schema_v2.sql"). Login requests save tokens into collection variables, so later requests are authenticated automatically.
